intro.text: The storm knocked out the station lights. Kabir is waiting for the last train home. Let’s get the signal working.
intro.speaker: harpreet

saveResume.text: We’re back at the station. Let’s pick up where we left off.
saveResume.speaker: harpreet

notice.text: Here’s the route board. Blue is North Bridge, amber is Mill Road, and violet is the depot.
notice.speaker: harpreet

ticket.text: My ticket says North Bridge. Will the driver know where to stop?
ticket.speaker: kabir

repair.text: The storm blew the signal fuse. There’s a spare on the bench. Put it in the panel beside me.
repair.speaker: meena

repaired.text: The signal has power again. Kabir’s ticket and the route board will tell you which route to set.
repaired.speaker: meena

foundFuse.text: A spare fuse. I’ll take it to the signal panel.
foundFuse.speaker: harpreet

dead.text: The route selector has no power. The panel in the cabin might explain why.
dead.speaker: harpreet

unknown.text: I need Kabir’s destination and the route colours on the booking hall notice.
unknown.speaker: harpreet

choose.text: Kabir is going to North Bridge. Which signal should guide the driver?
choose.speaker: harpreet

retry.text: Check the route board again. Which colour goes with North Bridge?
retry.speaker: harpreet

cantCombine.text: The spare fuse fits the signal panel inside the cabin.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

train.text: Blue signal. North Bridge is clear. Here comes the train.
train.speaker: meena

thanks.text: There it is! I can see the lights through the rain. Thanks, Harpreet.
thanks.speaker: kabir
